sentences.text: 2. It is submitted by counsel for the petitioner that the property of the petitioner was acquired and the award was passed by the Land Acquisition Officer.

Although the compensation for the house constructed by the petitioner was awarded but no compensation was awarded for Khasra No.153/14,
area 0.809 hectares, which was owned by the petitioner.
3. Considered the submissions made by counsel for the petitioner.

sentences.text: If the petitioner was not satisfied with the award passed by the Land Acquisition Officer under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1894"), then he had an opportunity to raise a reference under section 18 of Act, 1894 but that was not done, therefore, the petitioner cannot maintain an application before Collector for grant of compensation.

Furthermore, the Sub-Divisional Officer, Ramnagar, District Satna by order dated 7.2.2019 (Annexure P-4) has held that the petitioner had constructed the house after encroaching upon the government land,
therefore, the petitioner is entitled for compensation for his house only and not for the government land.
5 . The counsel for the petitioner has also not filed any document to show that the petitioner was the owner of Khasra No.153/14, area 0.809.

For the reason that not only the petitioner has failed to prove his ownership over Khasra No.153/14, area 0.809 but also the petitioner did not file any reference under section 18 of Act, 1894, no direction can be given to the Collector, Satna to decide the representation.
6. Accordingly, the petition fails and is hereby dismissed.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE TG /-

ORDER This petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India has been filed seeking the following reliefs :-
"7.1. To issue a Writ in the nature of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ, order or direction, to the Respondents to take a decision to compensate the Petitioner for the land which has been acquired by the Respondent;
7.2. To grant any other relief(s), which the Hon'ble Court may deem just and proper on the facts and circumstances of the case, along with the cost of this Petition."
opennyai_summary.facts:
If the petitioner was not satisfied with the award passed by the Land Acquisition Officer under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 1894"), then he had an opportunity to raise a reference under section 18 of Act, 1894 but that was not done, therefore, the petitioner cannot maintain an application before Collector for grant of compensation.
Furthermore, the Sub-Divisional Officer, Ramnagar, District Satna by order dated 7.2.2019 (Annexure P-4) has held that the petitioner had constructed the house after encroaching upon the government land,
therefore, the petitioner is entitled for compensation for his house only and not for the government land.
For the reason that not only the petitioner has failed to prove his ownership over Khasra No.153/14, area 0.809 but also the petitioner did not file any reference under section 18 of Act, 1894, no direction can be given to the Collector, Satna to decide the representation.
